name: services/tt/classgroups
description:
Get activities related to given user's study. This means, that if the user is also a staff
	member, then this method will NOT include entries related to his staff-activities.
brief_description: Get activities related to given class groups.

arguments.name: classgroup_ids
arguments.description:
Pipe-separated list of class group IDs. Since there's no such thing as a class group ID
	(each class group is identified by two columns, not one!), we have to develop one for the
	purpose of this argument. Class group ID is "unit_id|group_number", where unit_id and
	group_number are keys which identify the class group (you'll get something like
	"unit|group|unit|group|..." etc.).

arguments.name: partial
arguments.description: If set to true, response will be wrapped with PartialResponse object. This will allow invalid references to be treated as warnings, instead of errors.

arguments.name: start
arguments.description:
A date string, yyyy-mm-dd format. A first (earliest) day to include
	in the results.

arguments.name: days
arguments.description: Number of days (starting with start) to include in the results. No more than 7 is allowed.

arguments.name: fields
arguments.description: Pipe-separated list of informational fields/sections you're interested in. This must be any subset of keys, which are described in the returns section.

arguments.name: format
arguments.description: Format in which to return values. See supported output formats.

arguments.name: callback
arguments.description: Required only if you've chosen jsonp as a return format.

returns: A list of Activity objects, as in the classgroup method.
